decides: 点睛的那一笔——网点、速度线、粒子、颗粒。装饰是调味料，密度超三个就删

items.prompt: screentone texture applied as mechanical dot gradients for mid-values, consistent dot density per tonal zone, clean edges where tone meets ink line
items.note: 网点替代灰阶，是漫画语言

items.prompt: converging speed lines focused on the action point, line density thinning toward the frame edges, white gaps left around the subject for readability
items.note: 集中线把观众的视线钉在冲击点

items.prompt: sparkle star accents in four-point and two-point shapes placed on highlights, varying scale with depth, restrained to two or three focal points
items.note: 闪点是奖品感，多了变噪点

items.prompt: coarse film grain over the whole frame with faint gate weave, highlights faded warm, shadows slightly milky and lifted
items.note: 颗粒要均匀，局部加颗粒是脏

items.prompt: VHS analog artifacts, chroma bleed smearing color right of bright edges, horizontal tracking distortion bands across the lower third, scanlines over the whole picture, curved CRT vignetting
items.note: 介质损伤本身就是画面语言

items.prompt: drifting petals and leaves in varied scale and rotation, sharp near the camera and dissolving into bokeh with distance, wind direction consistent across all particles
lens flare from a hard light source, hexagonal or anamorphic streak across the frame, gentle bloom haloing bright edges, slight chromatic fringing toward the corners
items.note: 光晕要有物理来源，别凭空加

items.prompt: suspended dust motes visible inside light beams, density falling off with distance from the source, slow implied drift
empty speech and thought balloons with clean tails pointing at the correct speaker, uniform stroke weight, reserved as empty space for later text
items.note: 气泡尾巴的指向不能错

items.prompt: hand-lettered onomatopoeia marks as graphic shapes, ink-brushed katakana-style strokes integrated into the action, treated as texture rather than readable text
items.note: 拟声词是图形，不要求真读
